:::{#def-time-constructible}
#### Time-constructible function

A function $T$ from the nonnegative integers to the nonnegative integers is **time-constructible**
if $T(n) \ge n$ for every $n$
and some [Turing machine](#def-turing-machine) [computes](#def-tm-computes),
in time $T(n)$,
the function that maps each $x \in \set{0, 1}^*$
to the binary representation of $T(\strlen{x})$
[@arora2009computational, section 1.3].

:::
